impact: Tide Control. Hull contact. Steady there.
snag: Tide Cable. Line snagged. Back out along your track.
tension: Tide Cable. Line tight. Stop thrust.
battery: Tide Deck. Battery low. Prepare for recovery.
near: Tide Control. Target close. Approach slowly.
idle: Tide Cable. Line is clear here. How is your end?
harbor: Tide Control. On the pile survey, mind which side your line is on.
pen: Tide Control. Leave room to back away from the net.
openWater: Tide Control. Do you have the next checkpoint in sight?
check: Tide Deck. Still logging here. Do you read me?
